Event.description: Unique identifiers for marine species sampling events, formatted as alphanumeric codes.

Sample ID.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers assigned to marine species samples.

Expedition.description: Expedition identifiers for marine species sampling missions.

Date/Time.description: Marine species sample collection timestamps from 2004 to 2021.

Year sampl.description: Year of marine species sample collection, 2004-2021.

Vessel.description: Vessel names of research ships involved in marine species sampling.

Station.description: Marine sampling station identifiers, including numeric and alphanumeric codes.

Gear.description: Marine sampling gear types used in data collection.

Depth water.description: Water depth in meters, ranging from 0 to 738 meters.

Depth water_2.description: Water depth in meters, ranging from 5 to 3200 meters.

Location.description: Marine sampling locations categorized as Chatham Rise, Southern Ocean, Northeast Pacific, or Hawaii.

Latitude.description: Geographic coordinate representing location in degrees north or south of the equator.

Longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees, ranging from -158.259 to 179.03683.

Species UID.description: Marine species names, including Salpa aspera, Thetys vagina, Ihlea racovitzai, Soestia zonaria, Salpa thompsoni.

Species UID (Semantic URI).description: Marine species unique identifiers in LSID format.

Species UID (URI).description: Marine species unique identifiers as URIs from MarineSpecies.org taxonomy database.

Order.description: Marine species taxonomic order classification, primarily Salpida and Pyrosomida.

Size.description: Marine species sample size in unspecified units, continuous numerical data.

Tissue descriptor.description: Tissue descriptor categorizes sample types as whole, tunic, or stomach.

Method comm.description: Method used for marine species sample collection, categorized as FD or OD.

No spec.description: Number of species specimens collected in a sample.

Life stage.description: Marine species life stage classification, with categories O and B.

Con m.description: Marine species sample concentration in milligrams per liter.

Mass.description: Marine species sample mass in grams, continuous numerical data.

Sample dm.description: Marine species sample dry mass in grams.

Mass_2.description: Marine species sample mass in grams, continuous numerical data.

Ash m.description: Ash content in marine species samples, measured in percentage.

afdm.description: Marine species sample measurement in unspecified units, ranging 0.9 to 116.8.

afdm_2.description: Marine species sample measurement in unspecified units, continuous numerical data.

C/dm.description: Marine species sample concentration in carbon per cubic decimeter (C/dm).

N/dm.description: Nitrogen to dry mass ratio in marine species samples, unitless.

H/dm.description: Marine species sample measurement in unspecified units, continuous numerical data.

C/N.description: Carbon to nitrogen ratio of marine species samples, unitless.

C/N_2.description: Carbon to nitrogen ratio in marine species samples, unitless.

C/H.description: Carbon to hydrogen ratio in marine species samples, unitless.

H/C.description: Probability score ranging from 0.0806 to 0.7161, mean 0.2574.

Comment.description: Chemical composition percentages of carbon (C), nitrogen (N), and hydrogen (H).

H.description: Marine species sample measurement in unspecified units, continuous numerical data.

H2O res.description: Water resistance measurement in unspecified units, ranging 1.52 to 21.79.

Sum.description: Sum of marine species samples, measured in unspecified units.

Sum_2.description: Sum of a continuous variable, likely a measurement in unspecified units.

Elevation.description: Elevation in meters below sea level, ranging from -5371 to -3796.

961147.description: Earth and environmental science data on marine species samples, 2004-2021.
